note: Everything here is what was true when it was measured, not a permanent property of the world. Each entry carries a recheck date because on 2026-08-08 two items declared impossible were solved the same day. A constraint falling away usually moves the ETA more than any ordinary improvement does, so rechecks are ETA candidates in their own right.

constraints.claim: Creating a product on Gumroad over the API is supported. It is capped at 10 per day, not unavailable.
constraints.evidence: 2026-08-09 lifecycle probe: POST /v2/products returned HTTP 200 with "Sorry, you can only create 10 products per day." A daily cap is only imposed on an operation the API performs. The account still shows product_count 1, so nothing was created and there is no residue to clean up. The full create/read/delete path has NOT yet been observed end to end — retry after the cap resets before relying on delete.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: already large: removes the assumed 'one owner action to list a product' from every option that sells through this rail, which was the main reason some zero-base options ranked below others
constraints.note: The first classification of this same measurement was wrong: it recorded create_refused, which reads as 'the API cannot create products'. Rate limiting is evidence for a capability, not against it. The probe now separates the two.

constraints.claim: This environment cannot reach repositories outside the owner's own set.
constraints.evidence: git ls-remote on a public repo failed with no credentials; api.github.com/repos/facebook/react returned 403 through the proxy; GitHub MCP is scoped to the owner's repos.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: large: opens paid issue/bounty work, the fastest first-yen path found so far

constraints.claim: itch.io game pages cannot be created or edited by machine.
constraints.evidence: Server-side API exposes 6 read-only endpoints and no write endpoints; OAuth scopes are profile:me / profile:games / game:view:purchases, all read; butler pushes builds to an existing page but has no page-creation command (docs fetched 2026-08-08).
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: large: removes the only owner action standing between us and a fully automated distribution loop

constraints.claim: CrazyGames accepts submissions only through a web form.
constraints.evidence: Developer docs describe portal upload with build, SDK, metadata, cover art and trailer; no API mentioned.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: medium: 60% ad share with their traffic, but per-title manual work today

constraints.claim: This container has no ffmpeg, so video cannot be produced in-session.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: small: the cookie daily run already has ffmpeg in another environment

constraints.claim: Playwright cannot reach external sites from here, though curl can.
constraints.evidence: Recorded 2026-08-08 as ERR_CONNECTION_RESET; curl fetched itch.io docs successfully in the same session.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: medium: would make form-only surfaces reachable, though credentials would still be required

constraints.claim: MEASURED: with the default read-only sandbox, the automated ChatGPT path executes no commands at all. The model answers from the prompt text alone.
constraints.evidence: 2026-08-09 capability probe returned untested for all four checks with 'bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted'. Unprivileged user namespaces are restricted on the GitHub runner. The failure is silent from the caller's side, so earlier answers may have looked researched while nothing was ever read.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: large: Claude is the scarce pool and ChatGPT is not.
constraints.resolved_by: sandbox input added 2026-08-09; with danger-full-access the same probe returned read_cwd=yes network=yes other_repo=yes write=yes
constraints.note: This never blocked the zero-base blind step. That step wants a mind that cannot read our state.

constraints.claim: MEASURED: the automated ChatGPT path executes commands and reaches the internet, but cannot read our private repositories, and its working directory is an empty scratch dir rather than the checkout.
constraints.evidence: 2026-08-09 with --sandbox danger-full-access: api.github.com returned 200, api.github.com/repos/bachikoljunior-blip/note returned 404 (the unauthenticated response for a private repo), /tmp write succeeded, and `ls` in the working directory was empty because --cd is only set when collect_files is used.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: medium: would let the non-scarce pool take review and audit work off Claude. Two routes exist and neither has been tried: point --cd at the checkout, or pass file contents in the prompt.
constraints.note: Suits the blind step exactly as it stands. Delegating research and market work needs no repo access either, so this is not blocking today's candidates.

constraints.claim: PARTLY MEASURED: api.itch.io/profile/games authenticates and returns a games collection. Which per-game fields it carries is still unknown, because the account currently has zero games.
constraints.evidence: 2026-08-09: three dispatched runs. First two returned 200 with a games key that was not an array; the collector now accepts either container. Third returned status ok, game_count 0. The legacy itch.io/api/1/KEY/my-games endpoint returned 429 under repeated calls. fields_present is [] only because there are no games to describe.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: medium: decides whether the three funnel stages (found / opened / bought) can be separated at all. Cannot be resolved by testing — only by publishing a game.

constraints.claim: MEASURED: a Routine created with create_new_session_on_fire never fires. create_session called from inside a running session does work.
constraints.evidence: 2026-08-09: a one-shot Routine set for 04:26:00Z produced nothing by 04:35Z. Three independent observations — a poller checking origin every 20s for 14 minutes, a direct git ls-remote showing zero probe branches, and list_sessions showing no session created at that time (newest was from the previous day). The same listing shows sessions carrying parent_session_id created via claude_code_mcp_seed, which is the create_session path working.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: small: create_session from a live session already gives a clean context, so this would only remove one hop
constraints.note: A tombstone Routine from 2026-08-08 recorded the same result. Confirmed rather than assumed.

constraints.claim: RESOLVED for the child-session route: a session created with create_session has MCP. The warning applies to trigger-fired sessions, not to children spawned from a live session.
constraints.evidence: 2026-08-09: a child created with create_session started within 20 seconds, pushed its proof branch, and reported MCP: available after actually calling mcp__github__get_me (login=bachikoljunior-blip). Measured by calling a tool, not by inspecting a tool list.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: small: the lap is written to complete with git and node alone, so MCP is a bonus rather than a dependency
constraints.note: Design consequence: the parent only reads the gate and spawns a child. All thinking happens in a fresh context with full tools, which is what A12 asks for. Do not write laps that depend on MCP being present in the parent's own fired turn.

constraints.claim: UNMEASURED ON OUR SIDE, EVIDENCED FROM OUTSIDE: what blocks the only route on record that ever reached a first buyer is STANDING in the community the buyers are in — prior participation, an existing following, or several venues hit at once. Not recurring owner actions. Standing accrues before the post; it is a prerequisite, not a repeat action. Whether the owner has standing anywhere has never been checked, so this entry records a blocker whose size is unknown, not a blocker known to be present.
constraints.evidence: codex/outbox/2026-08-09.i.md, a survey commissioned to break honest_post_where_buyers_gather, plus codex/outbox/2026-08-09.h.md before it. Two counter-cases turn on standing rather than frequency: an r/Entrepreneur post removed 2026-02-19 under Rule 2 'No Promotion' (being honest that it is your own work is not an exemption when the post's purpose is promotion), and a post auto-removed 2026-03-20 because the author held under 10 comment karma in that community — the single post from a standing start was never shown to anyone. Against that, Invoker (published 2020-06-30, USD 90 the same day) records no audience at all and substituted breadth: Product Hunt, Reddit and Twitter at once. Three of the surveyed cases reached first revenue within 0-1 days of publishing. NOT MEASURED: our own standing in any named community, and whether any of the 28 published artifacts is worth posting. Nobody has looked at either.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: large: all seven zero-base options are now refuted and every one failed on the term this constraint names. This is the only route in the whole evidence set where a first buyer actually arrived, and the fastest on record. Written as 'five of the seven' when this entry was created at 11:05; codex/outbox/2026-08-09.j.md took the remaining two an hour later, which is why this constraint sorts first — nothing was moved by hand to put it there.
constraints.corrects: Route 1 (post where the buyers already gather) was excluded in state/zerobase.json distribution_answer on the ground that it needs recurring owner actions. That ground did not cover it. The exclusion elected route 2 (findable_surface_at_scale), which 2026-08-09.h then refuted, leaving the excluding constraint with no surviving route under it. Both surveys ended by asking a lap to take this deliberately rather than propose another build candidate. This entry is that decision: the recurring-actions ground is withdrawn, and standing is recorded as the real blocker in the file the picker reads. Until now it lived only as prose in zerobase.json, where no machine reads it.
constraints.two_ways_it_lifts: Acquire standing — participation that accrues over time, an owner action that repeats, and therefore genuinely expensive under this loop's constraints. Or substitute breadth, which is what the one zero-audience case on record did: several venues on the same day. Breadth is a single bounded act, so it does not fall foul of the recurring-actions constraint at all. Breadth is the cheaper test and has never been tried.
constraints.prerequisite_the_evidence_adds: In every fast case what was posted was a finished artifact the reader could try immediately — a working tool, a desktop app, a searchable database of real data. No case was found where a bare announcement sufficed. So this constraint cannot be tested until there is something to post, and whether any existing artifact qualifies is the cheap unexamined half.
constraints.note: measured_at is null on purpose: it records that OUR side is unmeasured, which is what makes this actionable now rather than a scheduled recheck. Do not backfill it with the survey dates — those are in evidence, and confusing the two would turn 'we never looked' into 'we looked and found nothing'.

constraints.claim: The main branch of Simple-browser-cookie-clicker-game must not be modified.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: not applicable: this is a standing owner instruction, not an environmental limit. Never schedule a recheck against it.

constraints.claim: MEASURED FROM OUTSIDE, DECISION NOT YET TAKEN: the priced product's FORM does not match the buyer class its own description addresses. The description addresses shops, cafes, salons, streamers and campaign pages, and asks them to drop an HTML folder on their own site and edit a config file. Every purchase actually confirmed for that class was a monthly SaaS with a browser admin panel, hosting or an instant URL, and setup help. Not one buy-once, self-installed kit purchase was found for that class. The price is NOT the blocker: USD 25 is below one month of every comparable found.
constraints.evidence: codex/outbox/2026-08-09.l.md, commissioned specifically to re-ask the buyer question after state/portfolio.json recorded that task .k had asked about developers instead. Paid cases: Le Petit Comptoir, a 40-seat Lyon restaurant, EUR 29/month for a QR spin-wheel, owner quoted 'I signed up that same day. 29 EUR/month'; an Italian ecommerce operator with no prior contact with the developer, USD 29/month, from a public revenue report. Comparables: MemberSathi NPR 200-1000/month, whose top tier is written 'built and managed for you'; Japan's ピピットガチャ from JPY 85,000 including hardware rental and operation. All four sell an operated service. The survey states plainly: buy-once kit purchases by this class — none found; commissioned-build prices for this class — none found.
constraints.why_recheck_is_today: The outside is measured; what is unmeasured is OUR choice between the two branches below. It is set due immediately so it reaches the candidate list on the next compute-eta run, because state/eta.json is generated and a finding recorded anywhere else is not read by the side that picks work. That is the failure this repository keeps rediscovering.
constraints.eta_effect_if_lifted: large, and it is the first finding that constrains the PRODUCT rather than a proposed shape. Seven surveys refuted candidate shapes; this one refutes the thing that already exists and already has a price. Until the branch below is chosen, every distribution route is aimed at a class that was not observed buying this form, which is why no venue work can fix it.

the_branch_it_forces.a_keep_the_form_change_the_addressee: A config-file kit with a commercial licence IS a form that has confirmed buyers — developers and agencies. codex/outbox/2026-08-09.k.md found them, named itch Game Assets with 38 clicker listings sold as top sellers, and put our USD 25 inside the observed band. This branch needs no build: it needs the description re-aimed. Cheapest by a wide margin. Note that agencies and freelancers build sites FOR shops and salons, so the end user in the current copy survives — only the payer changes.
the_branch_it_forces.b_keep_the_addressee_change_the_form: Hosted instance, or an embed snippet, or an install-for-you service, plus a form-based settings panel. This matches what the observed buyers actually paid for, and it is the branch the survey's own conclusion points at. It is also a real build with recurring hosting, and nothing here has established that we can operate a paid service.
the_branch_it_forces.what_is_not_the_branch: lowering the price. The survey says explicitly that USD 25 is not high and that there is no basis for a discount fixing this. Cutting the price would also destroy the ability to tell a pricing failure from a routing failure later.

constraints.bearing_on_the_pending_owner_request: state/owner-requests.json 2026-08-09.itch-page-for-the-kit is NOT invalidated by this and has NOT been rewritten — the request forbids that, and it is with the owner. itch Game Assets is a branch-A venue where the form matches, which this finding supports rather than undermines. What it does flag: the description_body_to_paste in that request is the shop-facing copy, so branch A would want it re-aimed at the developer or agency buying a licence. That is a decision for a later lap or for the owner, not a silent edit to a request already in flight.
constraints.not_established: that branch A sells either. .k found that developers buy kits of this genre; it did not find anyone buying OURS. The form matching a market is necessary, not sufficient — the same distinction state/eta.json already draws on the itch candidate under not_success.
constraints.note: The venue half of .l is real but belongs to the class in branch B: r/smallbusiness permits same-day zero-standing posting inside its weekly Promote-your-business thread, with the rule quoted and no karma or age numbers in the public rules. Do not carry that venue into branch A — it is where the class that was NOT observed buying this form gathers. r/Entrepreneur (10 comment karma, promotion banned) and r/shopify (30-day age, 20+20 karma, links banned) were both checked and both exclude us.
